MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 12
   D. 13

2. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

4. Solve for x: x + 5 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 6
   D. 7

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 12

7. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

8. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 1
   D. 17

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 36

10. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 4

11. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 56

12. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 1

13. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

14. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 122

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

16. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
